title: Oberwolfach Problem
exact_target: Determine precisely which collections of cycle lengths can form repeated spanning factors that partition all edges of a complete graph.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1421 (GRAPH-034). CC BY 4.0.
Peter Keevash and Katherine Staden, The Generalised Oberwolfach Problem, arXiv:2004.09937v1 (2020), Section 1, “Oberwolfach Problem (Ringel)”, page 1.
